headline: Charles Ran and Nhan Duc Nguyen break into ARC-2’s top 100

sections.text: Charles Ran climbed 1,683 places, from 1,741st to 58th, with a score of 33.89 (+11.95). Nhan Duc Nguyen rose from 1,749th to 85th at 32.92 (+12.09).
Both moves put the teams inside the top 100, turning deep-field gains into a visible chase toward the medal places. The public board remains provisional.
